text: My daily routine is quite simple, but I try to stay consistent. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a quick shower. After breakfast, I begin work at nine. I work from home, so I take short breaks during the day. In the afternoon, I exercise for about thirty minutes, either running or doing yoga. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a series, or read a book. I go to bed around eleven. Keeping the same schedule every day helps me feel calm, organised, and full of energy.
